questions.question: Is the site enrolled and approved in the U.S. Amazon Associates program, and is shopnow047c-20 active for this property?
questions.known: The owner supplied the tracking ID; the repository initially had no account evidence.
questions.unknown: Application/approval status, registered site URL, and Tracking ID status in Associates Central.
questions.howToFind: Check the logged-in Associates Central account and site list; verify the exact Tracking ID in the report selector before publishing Special Links.
questions.blocks: Disclosure accuracy and any claim that links are active Associates links.

questions.question: Which product and intended ASIN did the owner mean for each of the five submitted URLs?
questions.known: Five exact URLs were supplied. Individual page-reader re-opens surfaced five Amazon product page views: three with the Air Fryers breadcrumb and two in the Meat Thermometers category path. Those are observed destinations/categories stored separately, not intended-product confirmations.
questions.unknown: Intended ASIN, intended official listing URL, confirmation date, and confirmation source for every record.
questions.howToFind: Compare each link with the owner's source list or saved Associates Central link record. Confirm the product detail page and record the evidence and date before changing the intent fields.
questions.blocks: Product-specific copy, comparison, and purchase CTAs.

questions.question: Do the submitted links carry the intended Tracking ID and produce the expected Associates report entry?
questions.known: The selected Tracking ID string is shopnow047c-20. No link is represented as tested.
questions.unknown: Final click destination, tag attribution, and a corresponding report entry for each product.
questions.howToFind: Use an enrolled Associates workflow or Link Checker as appropriate; run one controlled test per product and check the account's Tracking ID/report. Record evidence, not just the URL.
questions.blocks: Replacing the inspection-only links with validated Special Links.

questions.question: Is PA API or Creators API access active, and which product content may this site use or cache?
questions.known: Amazon's public help describes prerequisites and separate policy terms.
questions.unknown: Account access, credentials, permitted program content, refresh cadence, and any permission needed for a model or data analysis use.
questions.howToFind: Check Associates Central eligibility and the current IP License/usage requirements before connecting an API. Do not scrape Amazon or send Program Content to a model without the required authorization.
questions.blocks: Automated pricing/review/product research and content generation.

questions.question: Which current product facts should be compared, and what evidence may be used for price, availability, reviews, competition, and commission?
questions.known: The requested fields are identified in the research schema; every value is presently blank.
questions.unknown: Current authorized price/availability data, permissible review data, competitors, category commission rates, and any first-hand evidence.
questions.howToFind: For product facts, use an authorized current Amazon source or manufacturer documentation and retain the source/time. Use Associates reports for observed performance; do not infer a rate or demand from the listing.
questions.blocks: Ranking products or making price, quality, popularity, commission, or conversion claims.

questions.question: Who is the named author, and what testing or firsthand experience may the publication honestly claim?
questions.known: No author identity or test records were present in the repository. The site uses the transparent role ‘Countertop Notes Editorial Desk.’
questions.unknown: Author bio, product access, test protocol, sponsorships, and substantiation for any endorsement or performance claim.
questions.howToFind: Add a real byline and dated methodology only after the owner supplies the identity and records. Otherwise keep content as a general decision checklist and do not call it tested or independent product testing.
questions.blocks: Product review language and endorsement context.

questions.question: Who can verify the GitHub Pages property in Search Console and submit the sitemap?
questions.known: The repository's configured public Pages URL is https://karagemop466-tech.github.io/Affil3/; sitemap.xml is generated.
questions.unknown: Search Console property ownership, verification token/method, and actual indexing/query data.
questions.howToFind: A site owner verifies the property in Search Console, inspects indexing, and may submit the sitemap. Review query and page reports after data accrues.
questions.blocks: Search-volume claims and data-led topic selection.

questions.question: Where will the self-hosted event API run, and what retention and security settings will govern it?
questions.known: The static GitHub Pages artifact and default preview both keep event sending disabled; the included local Node API requires explicit opt-in. The user request does not specify a public backend.
questions.unknown: A backend host, public API origin, retention period, operational owner, and whether a same-origin reverse proxy is available.
questions.howToFind: Choose a server host or reverse proxy that can run the included Node endpoint, configure a same-origin route and retention policy, then verify event counts in production. Do not enable a client endpoint that returns 404.
questions.blocks: Cross-visitor click measurement and real audience analytics.

questions.question: Which reader-capture service, privacy notice, retention period, and unsubscribe mechanism should be used?
questions.known: No address collection is enabled; the static build has no mailing service.
questions.unknown: Provider/endpoint, consent language, data controller/contact, retention, and working unsubscribe process.
questions.howToFind: Choose and test an email provider or self-hosted endpoint, publish a privacy explanation, and verify an easy functioning opt-out path before opening a form.
questions.blocks: Newsletter signup and the reader_signup event.

questions.question: Which buyer audience and search queries should the next article serve?
questions.known: Four editorial hypotheses were supplied for air-fryer/kitchen-appliance buying questions.
questions.unknown: Actual queries, impressions, audience geography, entry pages, and reader objections.
questions.howToFind: After Search Console ownership is verified and the pages have impressions, review Search performance by query and page. Treat suggested titles as hypotheses until those reports exist.
questions.blocks: Claims that a topic is trending, popular, or high-converting.

questions.question: Can the owner supply a canonical domain or contact details for publication and privacy pages?
questions.known: The current public GitHub Pages address is confirmed by repository settings; no custom domain or public contact details were configured.
questions.unknown: Custom domain preference, owner contact, and publication/legal contact route.
questions.howToFind: Choose a domain in repository settings and provide a monitored contact method before collecting personal information or publishing a named author profile.
questions.blocks: Branded-domain Search Console verification and operational contact details.

questions.question: What source-register definitions do S01, S02, S07, and S24 refer to in the user's notes?
questions.known: Those reference labels appear in the request, but no earlier source register or mapping file exists in the repository.
questions.unknown: The intended document/URL behind each label and whether those labels identify the same sources used here.
questions.howToFind: Add the original source register or map each ID to its authoritative URL. This implementation cites actual source titles and URLs without guessing the legacy ID mapping.
questions.blocks: A verified crosswalk to the referenced S01/S02/S07/S24 provenance labels.

questions.question: Which exact event names, triggers, payloads, and retention rules did the request's “five defined events” refer to?
questions.known: The request mentions five events but does not enumerate the schema. This repository proposes page_view, guide_open, site_search, outbound_click, and reader_signup as a starting point.
questions.unknown: The owner-approved event names, triggers, allowed fields, consent gates, and retention requirements.
questions.howToFind: Use the intended event contract if one exists, or approve/revise this proposal explicitly. Keep the default runtime disabled until the schema is approved and a separate endpoint is reviewed and deployed.
questions.blocks: Claiming the implementation matches a user-specified event schema or activating production collection.
